title: The Sickpools
summary: Pim Rushlight says the old vats under the Canal Locks are being drained by night, and he'd know: he buys what comes out. The Cult's harvesters are down at Vat Seven filling their cages for the Vatwarden.

steps.journal: Go down to Vat Seven, the Canal Locks' third floor, and break three full lantern-cages. Only the harvesters who lead the others carry a full one.
The cages are broken. Now the man who fills them: put down the Vatwarden in Vat Seven's hall. Keep out of the sick water when he opens the sluice.

ready: Three cages broken. Tell Pim, at his handcart by Saltmere's cistern.
done: Pim counted the cages twice, heard about the Vatwarden, and said his oil would be dearer now. Not sorry.
